items.informal_name: Galois Connection for Floor Function in Floor Semiring
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_4} {inst : Semiring α} {inst_1 : PartialOrder α} [self : FloorSemiring α] {a : α} {n : ℕ},
  0 ≤ a → (n ≤ FloorSemiring.floor a ↔ ↑n ≤ a)
items.informal_description: For any element $a$ in a floor semiring $\alpha$ satisfying $0 \leq a$, and for any natural number $n$, the inequality $n \leq \lfloor a \rfloor$ holds if and only if the canonical embedding of $n$ into $\alpha$ satisfies $n \leq a$.

items.informal_name: Floor Function Inequality in Ordered Rings
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring α] [inst_1 : PartialOrder α] [inst_2 : FloorSemiring α] {a : α} {n : ℕ}
  [IsOrderedRing α], ↑n ≤ a → n ≤ ⌊a⌋₊
items.informal_description: For any ordered ring $\alpha$ and element $a \in \alpha$, if a natural number $n$ satisfies $n \leq a$ (with $n$ embedded into $\alpha$ as the sum of $n$ copies of 1), then $n$ is less than or equal to the floor of $a$, denoted $\lfloor a \rfloor_+$. The floor function $\lfloor \cdot \rfloor_+$ maps elements of $\alpha$ to natural numbers $\mathbb{N}$, preserving the order relation with respect to natural number embeddings.

items.informal_name: Floor Function Preserves Inequality in Floor Semirings
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] [inst_2 : FloorSemiring R] {a : R} {n : ℕ}
  [IsStrictOrderedRing R], a ≤ ↑n → ⌊a⌋₊ ≤ n
items.informal_description: For any element $a$ in a floor semiring and natural number $n$, if $a \leq n$, then the floor of $a$ satisfies $\lfloor a \rfloor_+ \leq n$.

items.type:
